title: When No Answer Is Correct: Diagnosing Absent Answer Detection for MLLMs in Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2606.08239v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made substantial advancements in video understanding, yet the reliability of their responses remains underexplored. This work presents a diagnostic study of absent answer detection for MLLMs in video understanding, where the correct answer is deliberately excluded from the candidate set and a reliable model is expected to recognize that no valid option exists. We evaluate the absent answer detection behavior under three settings: multiple-choice questions augmented with a ``None of the Above'' option, open-ended generation with a detection instruction, and standard evaluation without any guidance. Across a diverse set of models and benchmarks, we find that MLLMs overwhelmingly select plausible distractors rather than detecting the absent answer. translated_title: 当“无正确答案”也是正确答案时：诊断视频理解中多模态大语言模型的“缺席答案”检测能力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.08239v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视频理解方面已取得重大进展，但其回答的可靠性仍未得到充分探索。本工作对多模态大语言模型在视频理解中的“缺席答案”检测能力进行了诊断性研究：正确答案被有意从候选集中排除，而一个可靠的模型应当能够识别出不存在有效的选项。我们在三种设置下评估了缺席答案检测行为：带有“以上皆非”选项的多选题、带有检测指令的开放式生成，以及不带任何指导的标准评估。在涵盖多种模型和基准测试的实验中，我们发现多模态大语言模型压倒性地倾向于选择貌似合理的干扰项，而非检测出答案缺席的情况。这种失败在时间推理任务中表现得更为明显，且随着帧采样的加密而进一步恶化。我们进一步探索了思维链提示方法（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本研究首次系统诊断了多模态大语言模型在视频理解中的“缺席答案”检测能力，发现当正确答案不在候选集时，模型倾向于选择貌似合理的干扰项而非识别出无有效选项，且该缺陷在时间推理任务和更密集的帧采样下更为严重。
en_tdlr: This work presents the first systematic diagnostic study of absent answer detection for MLLMs in video understanding, revealing that models overwhelmingly choose plausible distractors instead of recognizing that no valid option exists, with this failure being more pronounced in temporal reasoning tasks and worsening with denser frame sampling.
